events.title: MGK: Lost Americana Tour — with Wiz Khalifa & De'Wayne
events.story: Machine Gun Kelly's headline tour rolls through the amphitheater with Wiz Khalifa co-headlining — two of hip-hop's most recognizable live draws on the same outdoor bill. Lawn has been the move on this run; the stage production scales well to the back of the shed.

events.title: Santana & The Doobie Brothers
events.story: Two of classic rock's most enduring catalogs on one bill — Santana's guitar mysticism and the Doobie Brothers' Southern California groove make for a rare pairing that works better live than on paper. Floor seats tend to be the crowd's sweet spot here.

events.story: The synth-pop architects behind 'Sleepyhead' and 'Take a Walk' return in a rare intimate setting — The Hawthorn's 1,500-cap room is as close as you'll get to a band who typically plays much larger venues.

events.title: The Pussycat Dolls — with Lil Kim & Mya
events.story: A 2000s pop reunion on a grand scale — the Pussycat Dolls' comeback tour with Lil Kim and Mya in support makes for a nostalgia-heavy outdoor night. Tickets from $49; the pit has been the energy center on every stop this run.
